evidence: Modifies `src/common/config.cpp`, `src/common/init.cpp`, and `src/common/args.cpp` to harmonize datadir resolution and configuration loading.
rationale: Fixes a significant configuration defect where CLI tools silently fall back to default directories when a custom datadir was configured in the GUI. As the description notes, this mismatch causes tools to fail or 'downloading blocks into the wrong place' and miss existing wallets.
